figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: Extended Data Fig. 1 | Optical absorption spectrum of NiI2 at 5 K. Light  attenuation coefficient as a function of photon energy. A set of d−d transitions  and exciton states emerge across the near-infrared spectral range. The vertical  bars denote the photon energies used in our pump (ħωpump = 1.13 eV) and probe  (ħωprobe = 1.20 eV) experiment. Data is adapted from ref. 52.
